description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → the account is created and the user can sign in with it.
An already-registered email → a clear error is shown, and no duplicate account is created.
An invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors are shown.
A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
Required fields are: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
Password must be at least 8 characters.
Age is calculated from the date of birth; if under 18 the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown.

cases.title: Successful registration with all required fields valid, then sign in
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email newuser_unique@example.com is not registered in the system.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date that makes the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 1990-05-10).
Go to the sign-in page and sign in with newuser_unique@example.com / Passw0rd1.
cases.expected: The account is created (no validation errors shown) and the user can successfully sign in with the registered email and password.

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email is rejected and no duplicate account is created
cases.preconditions: An account already exists with the email existing_user@example.com.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date that makes the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 1985-03-02).
Check the account list / data store for accounts using existing_user@example.com.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown stating the email is already registered (exact wording not specified in the story), the registration is not completed, and only the one pre-existing account with that email exists (no duplicate).

cases.title: Invalid email format produces an inline validation error
steps: Enter date of birth: a date that makes the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 1990-05-10).
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown on the email field indicating the email format is invalid (exact wording not specified in the story) and no account is created.

cases.title: Password shorter than 8 characters produces an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email shortpass@example.com is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date that makes the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 1990-05-10).
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown on the password field indicating the password must be at least 8 characters (exact wording not specified in the story) and no account is created.

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted (minimum length boundary)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email minpass@example.com is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date that makes the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 1990-05-10).
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown; the account is created and the user can sign in with minpass@example.com / Passw0r1.

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register and sees the age message
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email teen@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date exactly 15 years before today.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: Registration is blocked and the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown; no account is created for teen@example.com.

cases.title: Customer whose 18th birthday is today can register (age boundary)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email exactly18@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: the date exactly 18 years before today.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is not shown; the account is created and the user can sign in with exactly18@example.com / Passw0rd1.

cases.title: Customer one day before the 18th birthday cannot register (age boundary)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email almost18@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: the date exactly 18 years before tomorrow (i.e. the customer turns 18 tomorrow).
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: Registration is blocked and the message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown; no account is created for almost18@example.com.

cases.title: Submitting the registration form with all fields empty
steps: Leave first name, last name, date of birth, email and password empty.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The form is not submitted and validation errors are shown for all five required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email and password (exact wording not specified in the story). No account is created.

cases.title: Submitting the form with one required field missing (date of birth)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. The email nodob@example.com is not registered.
steps: Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The form is not submitted; a validation error is shown for the missing required date of birth field (exact wording not specified in the story) and no account is created.
